   MINUTES OF WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 6, 2021
  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL
  LAND ACKNOWLEDGMENT STATEMENT (LAS) ADVISORY COMMITTEE

CALL TO ORDER

LAS Commission Chair Lubisich called the special meeting of the Land Acknowledgement (LAS)
Advisory Committee to order at 6:32 p.m. on Wednesday, October 6, 2021 with all
Councilmembers, Commissioners and staff participating by teleconference.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Commissioner Brenhaug.

ROLL CALL

Present:  Councilmember Menchaca, Councilmember Pu, Commissioner Brenhaug, Vice-
  Chair Jennings Nuñez, Chair Lubisich, Commissioner Mojarro
Absent:  None

ANNOUNCMENTS

Recreation Supervisor, Matthew Morales-Stevens, provided information for the public on how to
submit comments, and how to request meeting agendas. If you wish to address the LAS Advisory
Committee, e-mail all public comments to mmoralesstevens@sgch.org.

  1. APPROVAL OF AGENDA ORDER

  Hearing no objection, LAS Commission Chair Lubisich, announced the agenda order was
  approved.

  2. PUBLIC COMMENT

  None

LAS ADVISORY COMMITTEE SPECIAL MEETING MINUTES  October 6, 2021
   3. ACTION ITEMS

  A. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  A motion was made by Vice-Chair Jennings Nuñez, seconded by Commissioner
  Mojarro to approve the minutes of the LAS Advisory Committee Special Meeting
  for September 14, 2021.

  Motion approved as presented by a vote of 4-0-0 as follows:
  Ayes: Brenhaug, Mojarro, Jennings Nuñez, Lubisich
  Nays: None
  Abstain: None

  4. DISCUSSION ITEMS

  A. COMMITTEE TO REVIEW THE PROPOSED PURPOSE STATEMENT AND
  FINALIZE QUESTIONS

  LAS Advisory Committee members reviewed the purpose statement and list of
  questions for tribal leaders proposed by staff.

  Staff recommended to narrow some of the questions to fulfill the purpose of
  developing the Land Acknowledgement Statement.

  Community Services Director, Rebecca Perez, described some of the projects in
  which the tribes have worked with the City of San Gabriel.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Brenhaug, seconded by Commissioner
  Mojarro to approve the purpose statement and the list of questions with an
  amendment- the removal of the following questions: Should the statement also be
  translated into native languages? If so, what are those languages?

  Motion approved as presented by a vote of 4-0-0 as follows:
  Ayes: Brenhaug, Mojarro, Jennings Nuñez, Lubisich
  Nays: None
  Abstain: None

  Public Comment: None

  B. COMMITTEE TO CONTINUE WORKING ON THE LAS ACTION PLAN

  LAS Advisory Committee members continued working on the approved LAS Action
  Plan and discussed the logistics of meeting with tribal leaders.

LAS ADVISORY COMMITTEE SPECIAL MEETING MINUTES  October 6, 2021
   Staff recommends that the LAS Advisory Committee have one meeting with the
  Gabrielino and Kizh Nation, potentially on November 10 with a 15-minute break in
  between with specified time for the questions to be provided and responses given
  to be more equitable to both tribal leaders.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Mojarro, seconded by Vice-Chair Jennings
  Nuñez to approve the LAS Action Plan with the addition of bringing the Land
  Acknowledgment Statement back to the tribal leaders for approval prior to
  submissions to the respective commissions.

  Motion approved as presented by a vote of 4-0-0 as follows:
  Ayes: Brenhaug, Mojarro, Jennings Nuñez, Lubisich
  Nays: None
  Abstain: None

  Public Comment: None

  C. ADJOURNMENT

  Chair Lubisich adjourned the meeting at 7:49 p.m.

  Next special meeting to be tentatively held on November 10, 2021 via
  teleconference at 6:30pm.

   City of San Gabriel
  MEMORANDUM
DATE:  November 10, 2021

TO:  LAS Advisory Committee

FROM:  Matthew Morales-Stevens, Recreation Supervisor

SUBJECT:  LAS PURPOSE STATEMENT AND QUESTIONS

BACKGROUND

At the September 14, 2021 LAS Advisory Committee Meeting, the Committee requested
that staff develop a Purpose Statement and a list of questions for the tribal leaders based
on the Committee’s discussion. At the October 6 meeting the purpose statement and
questions were approved with amendments. Below is what was approved.

ANALYSIS
Purpose Statement: The Land Acknowledgement Statement serves as a clear and ongoing
commitment from the City of San Gabriel to respect and acknowledge the native peoples
of San Gabriel for their past, current and future contributions to the region.

Questions for Tribal Leaders:
    Do you want a land acknowledgement statement?
    How would you like to be identified within the statement?
    What are the indigenous names of places, sites and geographical features in San Gabriel?
    Can the names of the tribes be included in one statement?
    Are there programs where the languages are being taught?
    What are the ways you are keeping your culture alive?
    How many people from your tribe are still living in San Gabriel and the greater SGV?
    What work do you feel we need to do?
    What are present day challenges that you face?
    Are there organizations that support the cultures?
    How would you like the statement to be used?
    Allow an open ended option for them to share their stories.
